title: $10 Promo Credit on $250 Amazon Gift Card Spend (First 5,000 Orders) @ Amazon AU
body:
Deal: $10 Promo Credit on $250 Amazon Gift Card Spend (First 5,000 Orders) @ Amazon AU

[Disabled-User] I was going to tell you a joke about sodium, Na, and hydrogen… but NaH
[SKS01] 2.5% discount.
OMG! Have purchased 4,999 cards
[nickelanddime] Not a discount, $10 credit for the next order. However I agree with the sentiment, barely a bargain
[orangetrain] I never liked the first # deals. Burnt so many times when I'm often too late apparently.
[lordezekiel] Love watching people trying to convince each other that a free $10 is beneath them lol
If you gonna spend $250 on Amazon soon anyway, may as well get the credit, enjoy your free $10, buy items when on sale, many of which you can subcribe and save allowing you to triple stack discounts.
[onyx981] The only reason they keep reducing these discounts is because there's people like this that take the bait and still throw money at them.
Don't be surprised when they drop it to 1%
[alphaoasis] You will earn more if you leave your $250 in bank.
[justtoreply] This is even worse than the Woolworths tcn deal yet there's so many upvotes. You all supported this crap, now it's here to stay.
2.5% is not good enough.
